The target to tune PCP high automatically is as follows
- Minimize allocation/freeing from/to shared zone
- Minimize idle pages in PCP
- Minimize pages in PCP if the system free pages is too few
To reach these target
column2: a tuning algorithm as follows is designed

column1: - When we refill PCP via allocating from the zone
Because if we had larger PCP
column2: we could avoid to allocate from the

column1: zone.
- In periodic vmstat updating kworker (via refresh_cpu_vm_stats())
decrease PCP high to try to free possible idle PCP pages.
- When page reclaiming is active for the zone
high in allocating path
column2: decrease PCP high and free some pages in

column1: freeing path.
So
column2: the PCP high can be tuned to the page allocating/freeing depth of

column1: workloads eventually.
One issue of the algorithm is that if the number of pages allocated is
much more than that of pages freed on a CPU
column2: the PCP high may become the

column1: maximal value even if the allocating/freeing depth is small.  But this
isn't a severe issue
column2: because there are no idle pages in this case.

column1: One alternative choice is to increase PCP high when we drain PCP via
trying to free pages to the zone
column2: but don't increase PCP high during PCP

column1: refilling.  This can avoid the issue above.  But if the number of pages
allocated is much less than that of pages freed on a CPU
many idle pages in PCP and it is hard to free these idle pages.
1/8 (>> 3) of PCP high will be decreased periodically.  The value 1/8 is
kind of arbitrary.  Just to make sure that the idle PCP pages will be
freed eventually.
On a 2-socket Intel server with 224 logical CPU
in parallel (each with `make -j 28`) in 8 cgroup.  This simulates the
kbuild server that is used by 0-Day kbuild service.  With the patch
build time decreases 3.5%.  The cycles% of the spinlock contention (mostly
for zone lock) decreases from 11.0% to 0.5%.  The number of PCP draining
for high order pages freeing (free_high) decreases 65.6%.  The number of
pages allocated from zone (instead of from PCP) decreases 83.9%.
